Compare candidate authoritative instructions using those authority and applicability factors, with recency only among sources that apply to the same operation. Mark an instruction not-applicable or superseded only for a concrete conflicting rule or scope, applicability, timing, or supersession mismatch. Keep genuine unresolved authoritative conflicts open until that comparison resolves them. Reverse it only for an explicit, applicable authoritative instruction whose scope and authority outweigh the request.
